{'translated': 'Apple 在 John Ternus 時代展開之際，再度進行管理層改組。彭博今日一篇新報導指出，Apple 已任命新嘅併購部門主管，以及 App Store 新副總裁。', 'source': 'Apple is once again reshuffling its executive ranks as the John Ternus era gets underway. A new report from Bloomberg today claims that Apple has named a new head of M&A as well as a new VP of the App Store.'}

{'translated': '9to5Mac 由 Sony 贊助：Sony 旗下頂尖 BRAVIA 電視正進行大型減價優惠，涵蓋入門至旗艦型號，即買即慳。', 'source': "9to5Mac is sponsored by Sony: Sony's best BRAVIA TVs are on sale with massive discounts across the range, from entry-level to flagship. Shop now and save big."}

{'translated': '報導指 Apple 已任命 Steve Smith 為新任併購主管，接替 2009 年加入 Apple、帶領 M&A 及企業發展團隊逾十年嘅 Adrian Perica。彭博形容 Smith 係 Perica 嘅「長期副手」，佢將會向財務總監 Kevan Parekh 匯報。', 'source': 'The report says that Apple has named Steve Smith as its new M&A chief, replacing Adrian Perica, who joined Apple in 2009 and has led the M&A and corporate development team for over a decade. Bloomberg describes Smith as Perica\'s "longtime lieutenant," and he\'ll report to CFO Kevan Parekh.'}

{'translated': '至於 Perica 則喺 Apple 服務部門擔任「更顯要」嘅職位。佢自 2023 年起掌管 iCloud、Fitness+ 及 Apple News，未來將直接向服務業務舵手 Eddy Cue 匯報。', 'source': 'As for Perica, he will take on a "more prominent" role within Apple\'s Services division. He\'s been overseeing iCloud, Fitness+, and Apple News since 2023, and will now report directly to services chief Eddy Cue.'}

{'translated': '事實上，Perica 同 Apple Music 主管 Oliver Schusser 一齊，被視為 Cue 嘅潛在接班人：', 'source': 'In fact, Perica, along with Apple Music chief Oliver Schusser, are seen as potential successors to Cue:'}

{'translated': '此外，今日彭博亦報導 Apple 正擢升 Carson Oliver 為 App Store 副總裁，向 Cue 匯報。App Store 之前由 Apple Fellow Phil Schiller 主理，直至佢八月卸任。', 'source': 'In addition, Bloomberg also reports today that Apple is promoting Carson Oliver to VP of the App Store, reporting to Cue. The App Store was previously overseen by Apple Fellow Phil Schiller until he stepped down in August.'}
